author: Dunk
description:
Hi folks, as we move into autumn and winter, it feels fitting that I’ve been working on my Old World Dwarves. The snowy mountain bases and classic GW painting style suit this traditional, old-school range. I don’t need to spend time on battle damage or lighting effects after the main paint job, so the models move along at a nice pace and you see results in short sessions.

The post My Dwarf Lord and Warriors: red and green should never be seen… or should they? appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: My Dwarf Lord and Warriors: red and green should never be seen… or should they?
